obtain: This incantation can be located on a body behind/on the eastern side of Fort Gael in Caelid. It is guarded by two Flame Chariots.
lore: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.
Creates an invigorating fire within that enhances physical and fire-affinity attack power.
This incantation does not burn the caster, and so it is considered forbidden by the guardians of the Flame.
loreNotes: This incantation is regarded as one of the higher-level abilities among the Fire Monks.

name: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom
description: Aspect of the Crucible discovered in the ancient ruins. Creates a miranda flower on one's chest before calling down a rain of light. Charging increases potency. In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished.
obtain: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom is found in the upper sections of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of grace, head across the bridge just to the west, then drop down to a slightly lower bridge section at the end.
effect: Creates a miranda flower on chest to summon rain of light
lore: Aspect of the Crucible discovered in the ancient ruins.
Creates a miranda flower on one's chest before calling down a rain of light. Charging increases potency.
In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished.
loreNotes: This spell is very similar to the light spell used by Miranda Blossoms, Melina, and the cut Miranda's Prayer tool. However, this spell creates a flower at the beginning of its cast.
Patch 1.14 increased attack speed, increased the size of the hitbox, and shortened the recovery time between using this incantation and follow-up actions.

name: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns
description: Aspect of the Crucible that manifested in golden hippopotami. Creates a bristling mass of thorn-like fur on the caster's back before scouring the area by rolling around on the ground. Charging increases the number of rolls and range of attack. In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished. Remains of this can be seen in the ancient ruins.
obtain: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns is acquired by defeating the Golden Hippopotamus boss found just inside the main gate of Shadow Keep on Scadu Altus.
effect: Creates a mass of bristling thorns on back to scour the area
lore: Aspect of the Crucible that manifested in golden hippopotami.

In an age long past, before this land was enshrouded in shadow, the vitality of the Crucible flourished. Remains of this can be seen in the ancient ruins.
loreNotes: Patch 1.14 increased attack power and stamina attack power against guarding enemies. The close-range hitbox now follows the movement of the player.

The attack power was increased from 40% of Incantation Scaling to 45% for the uncharged hits and most of the charged hits, while the increase was from 70% to 120% of Incantation Scaling for the stronger charged hits.
Stamina attack power against guarding enemies was only increased for the charged hits, going from 50 to 85 against PvE enemies and from 62 to 106 against other players.

name: Bayle's Flame Lightning
description: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon in the right arm to smash foes with an exposed talon bone coursing with flame lightning. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.
obtain:
Dragon Communion: Foot of the Jagged Peak
Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Tyranny, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.
effect: Channels dread dragon to strike with flame-lightning-infused talon bone
lore: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

loreNotes: Patch 1.14 increased attack power.

This increased the damage of the initial hit, with the Lightning attack power going from 250% of Incantation Scaling to 280% of the same and the Fire attack power going from 190% of Incantation Scaling to 220% of the same.

name: Bayle's Tyranny
description: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon to emit a mighty roar accompanied by a heatwave burst, causing violent eruptions of fire in the area. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.
obtain:
Dragon Communion: Foot of the Jagged Peak
Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Flame Lightning, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.
effect: Channels dread dragon to roar with a heatwave blast
lore: One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

loreNotes: Patch 1.14 fixed a bug where some attacks of the Bayle’s Tyranny incantation did not hit multiple enemies and fixed a bug that caused the attack of the Bayle’s Tyranny incantation to go through certain terrain.
Prior to this update, the initial roar would only hit at most one enemy, regardless of how many were in range.

name: Divine Bird Feathers
description: A technique of the divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, wielded as an incantation. Spread the arms wide like wings to release a flurry of feathers. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to continue releasing feathers. The divine bird warriors, and indeed this technique, are said to bear resemblance to the golden Crucible.
obtain: Divine Bird Feathers is looted from a body at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. It is found in a body of water just east of the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance site of grace. To reach it, head north from the grace and keep to the right in the temple to arrive at the pool, where it's on a body just past a stone gazebo.
effect: Spreads arms like wings and releases a flurry of feathers
lore: A technique of the divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, wielded as an incantation.
Spread the arms wide like wings to release a flurry of feathers. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to continue releasing feathers.
The divine bird warriors, and indeed this technique, are said to bear resemblance to the golden Crucible.
loreNotes: Like Catch Flame, Divine Beast Tornado, Fire's Deadly Sin, and Flame Sling, this incantation does not display a spell sigil when cast.
Patch 1.14 decreased the minimum delay between consecutive hits and increased its range.

This change reduced the delay between hits, as feathers are launched every 0.1 second but before this patch each enemy could only be damaged once every 0.3 seconds. This inconsistency had effectively tripled FP costs against single targets.
Category:Divine Beast Incantations

name: Dragonbolt of Florissax
description: Special incantation of the ancient dragon Florissax. Calls down red lightning to bolster the caster and nearby allies. While enrobed with red lightning, all forms of damage negation (including physical) are increased. This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect. There was a time when the priestess never knew love, and thus never used this incantation herself.
obtain:
Quest Item: Jagged Peak
Given by the Dragon Communion Priestess at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after giving her Thiollier's Concoction at night and waiting for her to wake up (and then repeatedly talking to her), and then finally defeating Bayle the Dread.
This item is mutually exclusive with the Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel.
Continue talking to her and both confess to be the one that put her to sleep and accept her into your service to receive the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ash.
Since this requires Thiollier's Concoction, make sure to get that item by giving him the Blac
effect: Calls down red lightning to bolster self and nearby allies

name: Electrocharge
description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Calls down lightning to charge the caster's body. While charged, electric shocks will strike the area several times. Charging increases potency. The origin of incantations that bolster the body with lightning, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.
obtain:
Loot: Fog Rift Catacombs
Found by dropping down a hole in the second cubicle on the left at the third dropping spike-roof and then taking a left twice to find it in the same rooms as a Catacombs Sorcerer, some Fulgurbloom, and a few Skeletal Slimes.
effect: Calls down lightning to charge body with electricity

name: Fire Serpent
description: Incantation of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Launch a serpentine flame that bends and curls in pursuit of its foe. Charging enhances potency. When the flame they received from Messmer would not find purchase within them, the Fire Knights relied on fire incantations to honor their bond.
obtain:
Loot: Shadow Keep
From the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace, head west to find a ladder on a banister and head up it. Head right at the top of the ladder and take the stairs to another floor and continue forwards until you reach a small balcony with a body holding this Incantation.
effect: Launches a flame with a serpentine coil
lore: Incantation of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

name: Furious Blade of Ansbach
description: Incantation of Ansbach, Pureblood Knight. Produces a bloodflame blade from the side of the hand, then lunges at enemies to cleave through them. Charge to increase the number of slashes. Markedly different from the finessed swordplay of the dynast, this is an aggressive last resort of an incantation that gave rise to Ansbach's fearsome reputation.
obtain:
Loot: Enir-Ilim
Complete Sir Ansbach's questline while siding with him against Needle Knight Leda and defeat Promised Consort Radahn and then this Incantation (as well as Ansbach's Set and the Obsidian Lamina) can be found on his body, just to the right after entering the boss arena again.
effect: Cleaves through enemies with bloodflame blade summoned from side of the hand
lore: Incantation of Ansbach, Pureblood Knight.
Produces a bloodflame blade from the side of the hand, then lunges at enemies to cleave through them. Charge to increase the number of slashes.
Markedly different from the finessed swordplay of the dynast, this is an aggressive last resort of an incantation that gave rise to Ansbach's fearsome reputation.
loreNotes: Patch 1.13 increased attack power, fixed a bug where the “Furious Blade of Ansbach” Incantation did not apply Hemorrhage status build up.

For the uncharged spell the dagger slashes had their damage increased from 90% of Incantation Scaling to 97% of the same, and the final burst had its damage increase from 145% of Incantation Scaling to 154% of the same. The charged spell's dagger slashes had their damage increased from 90% of Incantation Scaling to 98% of the same, and its final burst had its damage increase from 145% of Incantation Scaling to 163% of the same.
Patch 1.14 cancelling this incantation into rolls will now take less time, increased poise damage, increased enemy knockback distance.

For the dagger hits the poise damage was increased from 4 (68 against other players) to 5 (85 against other players) and for the wave of fire the poise damage was increased from 2 (34 against other players) to 3 (51 against other players).

name: Ghostflame Breath
description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion. Transforms caster into a dragon to spew ghostflame breath. Charging extends duration. The land of spiritgraves is home to all manner of dead, and even the corpses of fallen dragons found their way there. Several of them were endowed with such vivacity that even in death, they could not fully die.
obtain:
Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak
Acquired from the altar at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 3 Dragon Hearts.
effect: Channels dragon to spew ghostflame breath
lore: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
Transforms caster into a dragon to spew ghostflame breath. Charging extends duration.

The land of spiritgraves is home to all manner of dead, and even the corpses of fallen dragons found their way there. Several of them were endowed with such vivacity that even in death, they could not fully die.
loreNotes: Despite not being a named dragon breath, it behaves like one. This means that the caster floats in midair and that it cannot be cast when riding Torrent.

This is effectively the second strongest "named" dragon breath attack, dealing 11% less damage than Smarag's Glintstone Breath and only 0.6% less damage than Agheel's Flame (the latter is only if an enemy's Fire Damage Negation and Magic Damage Negation is equal), and deals 8% more damage than Rotten Breath.

However, the, admittedly low, Frostbite build-up of the spell can even the field against non-immune enemies as it deals a significant amount of percentage-based damage and lowers their Damage Negation against further attacks.
Patch 1.07 the power of the following incantations in PvP has been decreased.

name: Giant Golden Arc
obtain:
Loot: Scadu Altus
Found in the Ruins of Unte, within the courtyard blocked by a deactivated Furnace Golem. Reactivate the Furnace Golem with a Hefty Furnace Pot thrown from the top of one of the outer ruins in order to enter the courtyard. The incantation can be found  in a chest within the courtyard shrine.
effect: Releases a giant golden arc with a swing of the arm
lore: Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.
A swing of the arm releases a giant golden arc. Charging enhances potency.
The arc resembles the barb, a known symbol of coercive questioning.

name: Golden Arcs
obtain:
Loot: Scadu Altus
Found in an already opened chest within the pit in Moorth Ruins in a shrine guarded by three Inquisitors.
effect: Releases a procession of golden arcs with a swing of the arm
lore: Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

The arcs resemble barbs, a known symbol of coercive questioning.
loreNotes: Patch 1.13: Fixed a bug that caused the "Golden Arcs" Incantation to generate attacks slower when cast with the left hand.

name: Heal from Afar
description: An Erdtree incantation discovered in the realm of shadow. Fires a projectile toward distant allies that greatly restores HP on contact. Even when far beyond, far out of sight, the Erdtree will surely give us its blessing.
obtain:
Loot: Scadu Altus
North of Moorth Ruins there are two small bodies of water. At the northern edge of the southern body of water is a small cave tunnel with a Miranda Blossom and three Perfumers, with the incantation lying under a glowing tree at the end.
effect: Greatly heals HP for distant allies the spell reaches
lore: An Erdtree incantation discovered in the realm of shadow.
Fires a projectile toward distant allies that greatly restores HP on contact.
Even when far beyond, far out of sight, the Erdtree will surely give us its blessing.
loreNotes: Though the description calls this an Erdtree Incantation, the sigil created on the ground when casting (two rings, one smaller and one larger, with script-like decorations on them) is that of a Two Fingers Incantation.
This has no mechanical effect as neither Incantation category has their spells strengthened by wielding a specific Sacred Seal.

name: Knight's Lightning Spear
description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear while also manifesting ancient dragon crests. On throwing the spear, the crests will launch additional spears. Charge to increase the number of crests and add a bolt of lightning to impact. An incantation that was taught only to the most accomplished knights, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.
obtain:
Loot: Scorpion River Catacombs
After arriving in the room with a spiked falling roof, keep to the right to find a ladder in one of the small safe spots around the corner (in the second half of the room) and climb up it. Cross the bridge to the right and then, after waiting for the Death Blight build-up to subside, use a thin ledge to the left to cross to the side with the Death Blight inflicting statue to find a short tunnel with the Incantation at the end, guarded by two Imps wielding Greatswords.
effect: Hurls lightning spear while firing additional spears from ancient dragon crests
lore: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Summons a lightning spear while also manifesting ancient dragon crests. On throwing the spear, the crests will launch additional spears. Charge to increase the number of crests and add a bolt of lightning to impact.
An incantation that was taught only to the most accomplished knights, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.
loreNotes: This spell is used by the Death Knights.

Patch 1.13 PvP-only adjustments: increased attack power of the initial lightning spear, decreased attack power of the spears launched after the first one, decreased Poise damage of all spears generated by this spell.
This increased the Attack Power of the first spear by 40% and decreased the Attack Power of the follow-up spears by 20% against other players, increasing overall Attack Power by 2% in PvP.
The patch actually increased damage to Poise done by this spell, doubling it.

name: Land of Shadow
description: Incantation originating from Scadutree avatars. Creates a hail of golden projectiles which are fired toward foes after a brief delay. This incantation channels the force of the Scadutree's power, and its gold is accompanied by shadow.
obtain:
Trade: Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower
Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
The remembrance is acquired by defeating the Scadutree Avatar.
After the Remembrance is acquired, a Wandering Mausoleum or Remembrance Duplication Coffins can be used to duplicate it. The spell can only be acquired once per new game cycle, regardless of how many remembrances are held.

description: The strength of Miquella upon his deific return, wielded as an incantation. Annihilates foes with a pillar of light. Miquella sought to accept all that was and would be, but found one that refused to be embraced. No wonder, as one god and one king consort, is all the world needs.
obtain:
Trade: Remembrance of a God and a Lord
Trade with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate the remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

description: An incantation of Messmer the Impaler. Summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency. Messmer despised his own fire. Time and time again he hoped to rid himself of it, but ever did it burn.
obtain:
Trade: Remembrance of the Impaler
Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

description: Incantation in praise of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. Summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. The apparition will remain for as long as the input is held. The Lord of Frenzied Flame shall take their torment, despair. Their affliction. Every sin, every curse. All melted away. Yet Midra, like others before him, was too weak to become a Lord.

loreNotes: The summoned orb is similar to the orb that replaces The Tarnished's head during the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
Patch 1.14 increased attack speed, increased Frenzy status buildup range against enemies, decreased Frenzy status buildup when using this skill.
The self-Madness build-up was reduced from 7 build-up per tick to 6 build-up per tick.

name: Minor Erdtree
description: Secret incantation of Queen Marika. Only the kindness of gold, without Order. Creates a small, illusory Erdtree that continuously restores the HP of nearby allies. Marika bathed the village of her home in gold, knowing full well that there was no one to heal.
obtain:
Loot: Scaduview
Found in Shaman Village, under a very, very small Minor Erdtree among a field of golden flowers. The path is guarded by a Tree Sentinel.
effect: Continuously heals allies in the area
lore: Secret incantation of Queen Marika. Only the kindness of gold, without Order.
Creates a small, illusory Erdtree that continuously restores the HP of nearby allies.
Marika bathed the village of her home in gold, knowing full well that there was no one to heal.
loreNotes: Patch 1.13 increased HP recovery amount.

Technically it lowered the amount of HP healed per tick, from 24 to 18, but since it also decreased the interval between heals from 1 second to 0.5 seconds the amount healed was effectively increased by 49%.
A version of this spell that summons a significantly larger tree is used by Melina when summoned against Morgott, the Omen King.

The size of the summoned tree was greatly decreased from the preview of Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, allegedly because its original size made it cause significant slowdown of the game when summoned.

name: Multilayered Ring of Light
description: Incantation of those who served Miquella. Produces a multilayered golden ring of light and fires it forwards, inflicting continuous damage on those struck by it. Charging increases potency. This light-ring incantation was cultivated by a tradition separate from Golden Order fundamentalism.
obtain:
Guaranteed Drop: Stone Coffin Fissure
Defeat the Phantom Misbegotten Warrior found past the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace along the main path through the area.
effect: Fires a multilayered golden ring of light that continuously inflicts damage

description: Skill of the pests known as the Kindred of Rot, now wielded as an incantation. Secrete numerous sticky threads, then twist them into two spears launched frontwards. Charge to enhance potency. The pests are abandoned servants, and it is for this reason that they found a mother in the Saint of the Bud.
obtain: Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh
effect: Secrete sticky threads and twist them into two frontward flying spears

name: Rain of Fire
description: Incantation of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights. Summons a cloud of flame overhead that pelts foe with rain of fire from above. Charging increases potency. Salza's disdain for barbarism never waned, even as he burned more villages and scorched more land than any other.
obtain:
Drop: Shadow Keep
Dropped by a Fire Knight in Shadow Keep that uses this spell, together with Salza's Hood. He's found at the end of the bridge just west of the West Rampart Site of Grace in the westernmost part of the Keep, and will try to target the player for large sections of the bridge unless line-of-sight is broken or Torrent is used to outrun the fire rain.

loreNotes: Patch 1.13 increased attack power, reduced the interval between each hit. Fixed a bug where the “Rain of Fire” Incantation sometimes did not hit enemies.

The Attack Power of the uncharged version was increased from 35% of Incantation Scaling to 52% of the same, and the Attack Power of the charged version was increased from 38% of Incantation Scaling to 63% of the same.
Prior to Patch 1.13 this spell was infamous for barely breaking into the double digits in terms of damage.

name: Roar of Rugalea
description: An incantation of what is jokingly called "the bear communion." Channels the power of Rugalea, the great red bear. Transform oneself into a great red bear and emit a mighty roar. Charging increases potency. An incantation that is more akin to the divine invocation of the hornsent than it is to the Dragon Communion. Only through desperate battle with the feral wild can one discover a god unique to oneself.
obtain:
Guaranteed drop: Rugalea the Great Red Bear
Roar of Rugalea is received upon defeating Rugalea in the woods in the northern part of the Rauh Base, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace.
effect: Channels great red bear to emit a furious roar
lore: An incantation of what is jokingly called "the bear communion." Channels the power of Rugalea, the great red bear.
Transform oneself into a great red bear and emit a mighty roar. Charging increases potency.

loreNotes: Patch 1.13 increased poise damage and attack power. Fixed a bug that sometimes interrupted the cast of the “Roar of Rugalea” Incantation.

This increased the damage of the uncharged roar from 80% of Incantation Scaling to 355% of Incantation Scaling. For the charged version, the power of the final roar was increased from 160% of Incantation Scaling to 200% of Incantation Scaling.
This also added an initial roar hit to the charged version of the spell, dealing damage equal to 250% of Incantation Scaling.

name: Rotten Butterflies
description: Incantation used by Romina, Saint of the Bud. Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction. The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud, gained by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

name: Spira
obtain:
